messages:
matt: Quick bench ask - want initial onboarding numbers for heracles-6b on hosted canary. Need P50/P95 and throughput for seq=1024, batch=1 and batch=8. Use int8 quant profile if available. Prefer smoke + 1 perf run. @julia can you take?

julia: on it, kicking off smoke now on canary-gpu-pool (mallory nodes). will paste logs.

deploy-bot: CI job triggered: ci/bench-heracles6b-canary-1861234567 (build 984) - started on mallory-03

julia: smoke finished, quick paste of aggregated latencies:
```
seq=1024, batch=1, int8: p50=210ms, p95=420ms, tokens/s=12
seq=1024, batch=8, int8: p50=240ms, p95=520ms, tokens/s=85
notes: KV cache warm; single-replica run; no batching optimization flags set.
```

matt: nice — can you re-run one perf with continuous batching (server-side batching) enabled and with q profile "q_opt_v2"? curious about p95 at low concurrency.

julia: will run. estimating ~30m. tagging priya in case we need extra infra. @priya any spare capacity on mallory-06/07?

priya: I can free up 07 for 40m starting in ~10m. which kernel flags should I enable?

julia: enable --enable-continuous-batching and set BATCH_MAX=8. use q_opt_v2 quant. also run with KV warm and cold if possible.

priya: running now. posting perf summary when done.

priya: perf run results (continuous batching, q_opt_v2):
```
seq=1024, batch=1: p50=225ms, p95=450ms, tokens/s=11 (-7% vs smoke p50),
seq=1024, batch=8: p50=200ms, p95=420ms, tokens/s=92 (+8% throughput)
notes: p95 regressed slightly for batch=1; batch8 improved noticeably.
flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/heracles6b/1861234567/priya-flame.svg
raw logs: s3://redwood-onboard/heracles6b/1861234567/priya-logs.tar.gz
```

liam: looks like the p95 bump on small batches is from attention kernel fallback - flame shows small-call path into fallback_attention_kernel. I'll open perf task and investigate. Task: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGINF-4521

matt: thanks. decision for rollout? temp plan: keep heracles-6b on canary with q_opt_v2 for perf testing, but pin production to model-version v1.0 (no q_opt_v2) until attention kernel fix.

julia: ack. i'll add bench artifacts + a short README to the artifacts dir and mark as canary-only.

priya: FYI I also ran cold-KV run, p95 jumped ~30% on first token - added cold-warm numbers in logs. good to know for cold-start sensitive workloads.

matt: action items:
- liam to investigate attention kernel fallback (ENGINF-4521)
- julia to upload artifacts + summarize bench to s3 and add to onboarding doc
- priya to re-run once kernel fix lands for confirmation

matt: artifacts location: s3://redwood-onboard/heracles6b/1861234567/ (julia/priya artifacts + flamegraphs). I'll update the model catalog canary note. cc @eng-runtime

julia: uploaded summary and artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/heracles6b/1861234567/summary.md (contains run commands + configs) :thumbsup:

matt: great, thanks everyone. closing thread, will track ENGINF-4521 and follow up on canary next week.
